subject: Request: Starter Pack pricing variance for QuantaScale - VP/CFO signoff needed
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@quantascale.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Starter pack — urgent pricing ask for pilot

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. QuantaScale is ready to kick off a 6-month pilot focused on inference cost reduction for our analytics pipeline. We like the Redwood starter pack (hosted API + 1 dedicated GPU burst pool + VPC connector) but need a commercial concession to move quickly.

High level ask: 35% off list for first 6 months, plus a $25k onboarding credit to cover integration work. We can sign a limited commitment (3.5M tokens/month floor) and convert to an annual commit if the pilot hits SLA targets.

Attached is a short PDF with their expected usage profile and timelines. Can you confirm if this is doable and what approvals are required on your side?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Platform Partnerships
QuantaScale

Attachments: QuantaScale_Pricing_Request_20261105.pdf (application/pdf, 34 KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@quantascale.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Starter pack — urgent pricing ask for pilot

Sara — appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Quick read-through: the starter pack + VPC connector is a good fit for a pilot but a 35% one-off discount plus $25k onboarding is outside standard delegated authority. I'm looping in Aditya (Dir, Enterprise Sales) and Marissa (Revenue Ops/Finance) to request an exception memo and VP/CFO sign-off.

Proposed signal to leadership: we recommend a 25% first-six-month concession + $15k onboarding credit, with two guardrails: 1) a token-floor of 3.5M/month and 2) a velocity clause — if usage drops below 50% of the floor for two consecutive months, pricing reverts to list (no retro). If leadership approves, we'll offer a DocuSign SOW with the conversion path to an annual committed plan.

I'll attach the customer's PDF and a short one-page memo with the margin impact.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: QuantaScale_Pricing_Request_20261105.pdf (application/pdf, 34 KB), QTS_SOW_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 48 KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Starter pack — QuantaScale pricing variance request

Aditya / Marissa — forwarding QuantaScale's ask and my suggested concession (25% + $15k onboarding credit with guardrails). Quick summary for decision:

- ARR profile: initial pilot (6 months) expected to average ~3.5M tokens/month. If converted to annual, they estimate ~12M tokens/month.
- Revenue impact (6 months at list): ~$180k gross; 25% concession reduces to ~$135k (delta $45k).
- Incremental onboarding cost: $15k (one-time).
- Strategic rationale: QuantaScale is a channel partner candidate (marketplace integration planned Q2 2027) and a public reference for financial services analytics. We risk losing them to Competitor A who quoted 30% + free onboarding.

Request: VP/CFO signoff on the one-off variance (25% / $15k) and permission to include a marketplace pilot clause that offers a co-marketing commitment contingent on conversion.

Attached is a short memo with P&L sensitivity and suggested legal language for the velocity clause (see the attachments).

Thanks,
Tessa

--- Forwarded attachment list: QuantaScale_Pricing_Request_20261105.pdf, QTS_SOW_v2.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 15:41:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Starter pack — QuantaScale pricing variance request

Tessa / Aditya — reviewed the memo and ran the margin scenarios. A few follow-ups before I can greenlight:

1) Please break out the unit economics (cost per token) for the pilot under the 25% concession vs list, and separately for the projected annual conversion profile. I need to see expected gross margin > 40% at the annual run rate (post-conversion) to accept the onboarding credit.
2) Convert the $15k onboarding into a milestone-based credit (payable 50% at kickoff, 50% after completion of integration and load test) to reduce churn risk.
3) Add a hard cap on total promo credits at $25k across all concessions for this account (internal control).

If those edits are made, I'm comfortable approving the 25% concession under delegated finance rules, otherwise this needs Marcus (CFO) sign-off for anything beyond $25k in credits or if margin falls below 30% at pilot run rate.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

[NOTE: I ran the sensitivity model; attaching the output as internal spreadsheet in the DocuSign packet if needed.]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Starter pack — QuantaScale pricing variance request (CFO signoff)

Team — thanks for the clear packet and the edits Marissa requested. I'm signing off with the following final conditions:

1) Approve a 25% discount for the first 6 months only.
2) Onboarding credit capped at $15k, paid 50/50 (kickoff / integration acceptance).
3) Include the velocity clause (revert to list pricing if usage <50% of floor for two months) and a marketplace co-marketing commitment in the SOW.
4) Any conversion to an annual committed contract must target a minimum gross margin of 40% at the annualized run rate; legal to include a 30-day review clause if margin projection falls short.

Tessa — you have signoff to proceed with DocuSign and include the hubspot deal HS-124578. Keep finance copied on the signed SOW.

Marcus Lin
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: Signed approval memo (internal) — not attached to external email]
